prompt:
Create a sheet of NINE BLUEPRINT LINE-ART CARDS in a 3x3 grid.
REFERENCE1 = exact nine target items in order, preserve each object's silhouette, composition and viewing angle faithfully. REFERENCE2 = previous teal-blue blueprint card sheet, use ONLY card color, fine grid and delicate white contour style. Unlike reference2, absolutely NO dimension arrows or measurement marks.

One square sheet, nine identical square rounded cards, deep teal-blue (#17627d range), very faint low-contrast fine square grid. Equal corner radius and card size, generous equal transparent gutters and outside border. No drop shadows.
Each card contains ONLY its centered object drawing and faint background grid. Object drawing centered at exact middle, contained in middle 60% of card with ~20% or more empty breathing room on all sides. Keep right margin as generous as left. Complex groups must be scaled down rather than encroach on border.
ONLY WHITE THIN LINE ART. Uniform stroke weight for all silhouettes and internal details. No colored surfaces, no white solid fills, no color accents, no shading, no gradients, no hatching. Card grid remains visible through all object surfaces. Charming simple cartoon game objects, not engineering cross sections.
FORBIDDEN: dimension lines, arrows, measurement tick marks, corner brackets, registration marks, labels, letters, numerals, captions, decorative symbols or any marks outside the depicted object. Do not copy ANY arrows from reference2. Remove the medical scan's yellow corner bracket entirely. Preserve ordinary pictograms belonging to objects (globe, leaf, check, chart, bone) as thin outlined shapes; no text.

Order and exact subjects from reference1:
TOP LEFT: articulated robot harvest arm on small wheeled base, gripper picking apple from short branch with two leaves. Same angle and arrangement.
TOP MIDDLE: rectangular X-ray light panel with two clips and ribcage image, same slight 3/4 angle; trace rib bones with fine white outlines, not filled white bones. Omit scanning corner bracket.
TOP RIGHT: nutrition kiosk pedestal with screen showing three simple outlined bars, shelf with bowl and apple. Same angle.
MIDDLE LEFT: small theater with open curtains, earpiece in front and globe speech bubble beside it, same arrangement. All features including curtain folds as fine unfilled line art.
MIDDLE CENTER: rounded pet camera treat dispenser with circular lens, bone pictogram and bowl at front left.
MIDDLE RIGHT: tilted photo-translator smartphone in front of a little paper menu, globe speech bubble on screen, cloche food pictogram on paper. The menu's short generic lines may be represented as simple thin strokes, no lettering.
BOTTOM LEFT: tilted plant-identification phone with leaf and circular check icon on screen.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: pole-mounted road safety camera above small crosswalk patch; outline crossing stripes, do not fill stripes white.
BOTTOM RIGHT: low round robot vacuum, oval top ring and small top button, front bumper, same angle as original.

No greenhouse as a tenth card. Exactly nine requested objects. Do not redesign them. Only rendering conversion to fine white line work on identical dark teal graph-paper cards. NO arrows or measurements anywhere.
